sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:11

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:11:1
items.html: Those that are only the Nekudot of SAG are not called SAG like the whole: As above in the adjacent item, that the ten Sefirot of Nekudim are sometimes called by the name SAG, since their vessels are from the Nekudot of SAG, meaning from its lower half. And this is what he says, “that those that are only the Nekudot of SAG are not called SAG like the whole, for they are but a single detail,” since the essential part of SAG is the Taamim in it, whose meaning is the time before the screen in it began to refine, when there is there a level of Hochma, as is known. But after it began to refine from that level, there is no longer in it the level of SAG. And see above in the Inner Light (page 390, the passage beginning “And SAG”), study it there well, for it is explained there at length.
